description: The fixture set and the expectation-row members of the corpus at the version this document records. The suite compares it with corpus/corpus.json, corpus/fixtures/ and corpus/expect.schema.json on disk, so a fixture or an expectation member added while corpus_version still names the version recorded here fails, and moving the version and rewriting this document in one change is the green path. The rule corpus.json states for itself is what this document enforces: the minor number moves when a fixture or an optional field is added. Nothing outside this repository reads it, and no analyzer implements anything on account of it.
